1990s-retro-hand-drawn-anime-style.mp4.prompt: 1990s retro hand-drawn anime style, dramatic low-angle panning shot. A colossal weathered biomechanical robot covered in overgrown moss and vines stands dormant in a flooded post-apocalyptic city square. Suddenly, its visor flickers to life with a bright amber glow, sending ripples across the surrounding water and startling a flock of white birds that fly upward across the frame. Wind blows tall grass in the foreground, dramatic cumulous clouds moving in the sky, nostalgic cel-shaded aesthetic.

ideogram_fanta-007_.png.prompt: Vintage 1950s Fanta poster featuring a woman holding the bottle

sectores.desc: A smiling woman with a retro aesthetic occupies the center of the poster. She has reddish-brown hair styled in voluminous waves, well-defined eyebrows, and classic makeup. She is wearing a red, open-collared blouse. Her face conveys joy and warmth, with her gaze directed toward the viewer.
The word “FANTA” appears in large, bold, white capital letters against a reddish-orange band. It is the most striking typographic element and spans a large portion of the poster's lower width.
Below the brand name, the words “Delicious and Refreshing” appear, arranged over two lines in thick, dark lettering. The text highlights the product's qualities of flavor and freshness.

In the opposite hand, he holds a clear, cylindrical glass filled with an orange-colored drink. The glass is positioned at approximately shoulder height and visually complements the bottle, reinforcing the idea of immediate consumption.

The woman is holding a clear glass bottle containing an orange-colored drink. The bottle features a green and white label with the brand name Fanta. It has a narrow neck and a metal cap. She holds it at chest level, highlighting it as one of the featured products.
